title: You Are My Sunshine
lyrics_synced:
[00:02.37] The other night, dear, as I lay sleeping
[00:10.10] I dreamed I held you in my arms
[00:17.83] When I awoke, dear, I was mistaken
[00:26.09] So I hung my head and I cried.
[00:33.40] You are my sunshine, my only sunshine
[00:41.12] You make me happy when skies are gray
[00:48.80] You'll never know, dear, how much I miss you
[00:57.10] Please don't take my sunshine away
[01:04.32] I'll always love you and make you happy,
[01:12.05] If you will only say the same.
[01:19.79] But if you leave me to love another,
[01:28.04] You'll regret it all some day:
[01:35.25] You are my sunshine, my only sunshine
[01:43.04] You make me happy when skies are gray
[01:50.74] You'll never know, dear, how much I miss you
[01:59.02] Please don't take my sunshine away
[02:06.77] Please don't take my sunshine away
